# Exiled Casual: full description

> Exiled Casual is a free action role-playing game (ARPG) that runs entirely in a web
> browser, with nothing to install. It is inspired by Path of Exile 1 and 2 and takes the
> best of either where they differ. It is an original fan project with original code and
> art, not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Grinding Gear Games.

Website: https://exiledcasual.com/ (the game itself)
Source code: https://github.com/IT-BAER/exiled-casual
Developer: IT-BAER (https://github.com/IT-BAER)
Status: early development build, playable, changes often, balance not final.
Price: free.

## How to play

Open https://exiledcasual.com/ in a current desktop browser with WebGL2. Choose PLAY, pick local mode, create a character from one of the
classes, and enter the hideout. Local mode keeps one character and saves it in the
browser (IndexedDB); the save can be exported and imported as JSON. The site can be
installed as a web app from the browser menu.

## Game loop

- A hideout with a map device that opens six portals per run.
- An Atlas of map nodes, opened with Waystones held in the inventory. A map can be
  prepared with modifiers before it is opened. Unexplored parts of the Atlas are fogged.
- Procedurally generated maps across several biomes, assembled from authored chunks,
  plus an open coastal map (the Strand) with surf, wet sand, shells and wreckage.
- Each map ends in a boss arena; one boss fights in two phases.

## Combat

- Real-time, click-to-move combat on a deterministic 30 Hz simulation.
- Each class has its own free default attack plus skills with costs and cooldowns.
- Ailments and buffs; monsters route around walls rather than getting stuck on them.

## Items and loot

- Four rarities: normal, magic, rare and unique.
- Prefix and suffix affixes, implicit modifiers, and identification of unidentified items.
- Crafting orbs change an item's rarity or modifiers.
- Loot beams mark valuable drops; containers in maps pay out when clicked.
- A shared stash, a vendor, and disenchanting of unwanted items.
- Character stats derive from equipped items.

## Character growth

- A passive tree of 239 nodes across eight disciplines.
- Each class starts at its own door into the tree. Notables open once most of their
  cluster is taken; travel bridges connect areas; keystones trade one stat for another.
- Single passive points can be refunded.
- The 3D character shows the equipped armour; each class has its own full armour set.

## Options

Graphics and audio mixes, HUD toggles, rebindable keys, and a debug log channel.

## Technology

TypeScript, React 19 and Babylon.js 9 (WebGL2), built with Vite. The simulation is a
hand-rolled entity-component system in a Web Worker, using fixed-point integer math and
named seeded random streams, so a run replays to an identical checksum. The client sends
intents, never outcomes; the simulation re-validates range, cost and placement.

## FAQ

Is Exiled Casual free?
Yes. It is free to play in the browser.

Do I need to download or install anything?
No. It runs in the browser. Installing it as a web app is optional.

Is it Path of Exile?
No. It is an original game inspired by Path of Exile 1 and 2. It ships none of their art,
audio or data, and it is not affiliated with Grinding Gear Games.

Is there multiplayer or an online mode?
Not yet. Online mode with accounts is planned. Local mode works today.

Does it work on phones?
It targets desktop browsers. Mobile browsers are not a supported target yet.

Where is my save stored?
In your browser's local storage (IndexedDB). Clearing site data deletes it, so export the
save as JSON to keep a copy.
